title: Katana Spear
description: Makes the diamond spear into a cool katana!
body:
# ⚔️ Katan Spear

Turn the **Diamond Spear** into a sleek, stylish **katana** with this simple resource pack.

## ✨ Features

* 🗡️ Replaces the **Diamond Spear** model with a cool katana.
* 🎨 Clean design that fits Minecraft's style.
* ⚔️ Perfect for players who prefer a samurai-inspired look.
* 📦 Lightweight and easy to use.
